parsed.why: Low-risk tier: gender-identity discrimination banned and enforced by commission with remedies, city sanctuary shielding visitors from outside enforcement, no facility ban, no criminal statute. Only gap: no hate-crime coverage. National border/custody regime caps it.

Upheld criminal ban on gender-expressive performance, birth-sex facility, shelter and prison rules, indecent-exposure bathroom statute, closed documents, police indifference, panic defence. Killing-rate figure is an undercount floor — disregarded.

Worst tier: bounty suits plus criminal/civil fines for wrong-sex facility use in public buildings including airports, licences invalidated, hostile state with working enforcement. Do Not Travel designation; protection statute no longer operating.

No adult facility or care ban; Moderate-Risk tier. But no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage, and board-driven youth restrictions; visitor outside four municipal ordinances has no recourse.

Birth-sex restroom rule reaches public schools, colleges and universities; prison treatment restrictions; no hate-crime statute; unrepealed sodomy provision (dead letter). No adult criminal statute or statewide adult facility ban.
